rules.message: The wizard region needs an id — every response swaps the whole section back (outerHTML), so the id must round-trip.
Swap the whole region with outerHTML — an inner swap would duplicate the stepper. (outerHTML must be declared: htmx's default is innerHTML.)
Keep method/action alongside data-hx-post — the wizard's no-JS path is classic pages at real step URLs.
Navigation is a named submit of the step form: a button with name="nav" value="next".
Every back button must carry formnovalidate — without it, required fields on the current step trap the user (drafts are saved unvalidated; only next validates).
Exactly the current step carries aria-current="step" on the stepper.
Disable the submits during the request (data-hx-disabled-elt).
